subject: general
question: Which is the highest peak of the Aravalli Mountain Range?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Shikhar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Peak on Mount Abu** is the tallest peak in the Aravalli Range **(5,650 feet [1,722 metres]).**
 
• The Aravali Range is a range of mountains in western India running about** 692 km** in a northeastern direction over the** Indian states of Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Haryana, ending in Delhi.**
 
• Guru Shikar is situated at a** height of 1772 meters** above sea level, and people can enjoy the vision of the **Mount Abu region from this peak.**
 
• People **can see the temple of Guru Dattatreya on this peak.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chaukhamba peak** is situated in the** northern Indian state of Uttarakhand.**
 
• **Kamet** is the second tallest mountain in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India, after Nanda Devi. 
 
• **Saltoro Kangri, **previously famous as** Peak 36, is the highest peak of the Saltoro Mountains subrange of Karakoram range.**
